spec: Revision/SPEC.md section 9, theorem T3 (the Kohn-Sham level): numerical demonstration with the independent Revision reference solver (a demonstration, not part of the proof)
method: Revision/kohn_sham/reference/ks_fd.py (read only) for plus (m, lambda, tip 0) and control (-m, +lambda, tip 0); for the image (-m, +lambda, tip pi) the reference's rotated frame with the tip end rotated by pi/2 (phi(-L) = j pi/2), supplied here; Richardson over G = 300, 600, 1200 (run_reference.rich3)
background: slices of the PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND history a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{(4/3) A H x4} (A = 1; x5, x6, x7 deflating as e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} = b4(0)^{1/2} e^{-a4/3}); lambda_hat fixed per tag, Vol_7(a4,0) = ell^3 v_t e^{(5/3) a4,0}; the Kohn-Sham states violate the source conditions of the a4 and b4 equations (Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json)

checks.name: image_frame_theta_pi
checks.detail: the rotated frame with a general tip end: for theta = 0 it gives the reference's sector matrices bit for bit (identical, 340 sectors, non-constant M(y), v(y)); for the image problem (-M, tip theta = pi) on G = 300, 600, 1200 (Richardson) the k = 0 levels at a4,0 = 0 (f = 1) equal the exact image spectra (odd fold condition: eps = 0 and sqrt(M^2 + (n pi/L)^2); even: tan(pL) = -p/M, the spectra of (M, theta = 0) with the fold conditions exchanged) for (M, L) = (1, 3), (2, 3): max |difference| 2.80e-14 (tolerance 1e-9)

checks.name: all_members_converged
checks.detail: 18 states: the plus and image members of every state and the control members of 18 states (in the other 0 the reference found no self-consistent control state, check negative_control_untransformed_tip), each on G = 300, 600, 1200: SCF residual <= 9.77e-15 (tolerance 1e-12 of the reference), the same label set on every grid, and the key sets of plus and image equal after the map (n2, j, fold condition, rank) -> (n2, -j, other fold condition, rank)

checks.name: t3_equal_ground_states
checks.detail: 13 ground states (N = 8: lam0, lamp2, lamm2 x a4,0 = 0, 1, 2; N = 592: lamp2, lamm2 x a4,0 = 0, 2), Richardson values: levels by key (eps, occupation, degeneracy), E_KS, E_band, E_int, the EMT integrals (rho, p3, p_t, p0, n), N, HOMO, LUMO, KS gap, the profiles n, v_v, e_int, rho, p3, p_t, p0 (equal) and S, Q, M_eff (opposite sign) of the image (-m, +lambda, tip pi) equal those of the plus state: worst 1.332e-14 (N592_lamp2_a20), tolerance 1e-09. On a single grid the levels of the two members differ by up to 1.81e-04: the image's rotated frame is not the discrete image of the plus frame, so the two discretisations differ at O(h^2), and the equality appears in the extrapolated (continuum) values

checks.name: t3_equal_thermal_states
checks.detail: 5 Mermin states (N = 8, lamp1 x a4,0 = 0, 2 x T = 0.01, 0.05; N = 592, lamp1, a4,0 = 2, T = 0.05): levels and occupations, mu, entropy, E_KS, Omega = -T sum g ln(1 + e^(-(eps - mu)/T)) - E_int, F = Omega + mu N, EMT integrals and profiles (S, Q, M_eff with opposite sign): worst 3.159e-14 (N8_lamp1_a00_T50), tolerance 1e-09

checks.name: negative_control_untransformed_tip
checks.detail: control (-m, +lambda) with the UNtransformed tip theta = 0, solved by the unchanged reference, in all 18 states: the density profile alone, max_y |n_control - n_plus| / max_y |n_plus|, is at least 3.776e+00 (N592_lamp2_a00); the combined measure (that, the sorted (eps, degeneracy) list, E_KS, EMT integrals) at least 9.200e+01 (N8_lamp1_a00_T10); required > 1e-06, where the reference found a self-consistent control state; states where it found none (SCF not converging, which separates them from the converged image as well; it does not show that no such state exists): none

checks.name: reference_image_equals_rust_image
checks.detail: the -M universe (-m, +lambda, tip pi) solved by the two independent solvers: reference (finite differences, Richardson) against the Rust solver (shooting, RK4; numerics/results/t3-rust-states.csv) in 18 of 18 states: E_KS, the EMT integrals and (thermal) mu and Omega agree to 7.311e-11 (N592_lamp1_a20_T50), tolerance 1e-08

checks.name: history_is_a_prescribed_background
checks.detail: the slices belong to the history a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{(4/3) A H x4} (extra times deflating as e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} = b4(0)^{1/2} e^{-a4/3}); ks-theory.json adiabaticity.historyStatus: 'PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND: the history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^{(4/3) H x4} is prescribed, not solved for. With the author's Lovel...' (Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json: the Kohn-Sham states are not admissible sources); T3 holds slice by slice
